path_rule: g5_ur0_ and test_g5_ur0_ are explicit new Node/Python test basename prefixes under verification/tests, not replacement of unrelated existing tests.
source_edit_rule: qualifier-gated observation only; unchanged branch conditions/algorithms/return/commit/present/recovery/budget ordering. CMake only private option/exports/non-install variant and tests.
forbidden: normal root JS/DLL public API or exports
new Session debug/business commands or Runtime mutable accessors
Skia/Protobuf rebuild or dependency/descriptor/schema lock edit
navigation canonical receipt/new sync completion wait
product bug fixes outside observation instrumentation

private_build.normal_install: no new private exports/headers/archives or qualification interface; qualification artifact cannot be released as normal consumer SDK
private_build.raw_access: only verification loader captures internal module in isolated staging; root createRuntime used for all business/input work

transport.control_arguments: fixed opcode uint32 plus uint32 value; unknown/reentrant/late lifecycle op rejects safely
transport.buffer: module-owned borrowed bytes, uint32 length; invalid after next control/reset/close, copy immediately, no caller free/transfer
transport.identities: u64 decimal strings and128-bit hex on out-of-band drain; pointer values never canonical IDs
transport.thread: existing owner thread; GPU callback diagnostics use lifetime-safe bounded state, never capture Runtime/provider

private_build.native_unit_test_exception: Collector-only native test targets may enable target-local observation objects; never linked or installed into ordinary native consumer SDKs.

diagnostic_budget_rule: aggregate across pending diagnostic runs; not extra Render coverage/staging quota; exhaustion never changes product result; critical loss invalidates affected evidence
